# Golana.online

> Golana.online provides free, browser-based tools for PDF editing, document conversion, calculators, media editing, developer utilities, games, WhatsApp business, HR, marketing, education, health, and more. All tools run entirely in the browser with no installation required.


## PDF & Document Tools

- [PDF Merger](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-merger): Combine multiple PDFs into one document.
- [PDF Splitter](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-splitter): Split a PDF into separate pages or ranges.
- [PDF Compressor](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-compressor): Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality.
- [PDF to DOCX](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-docx): Convert PDF pages into editable text.
- [DOCX to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/docx-to-pdf): Convert simple DOCX files to PDF in your browser.
- [TXT to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/txt-to-pdf): Turn plain text files into a clean PDF.
- [Images to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/images-to-pdf): Combine images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to Images](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-images): Export each PDF page as an image.
- [PDF to Excel](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-excel): Convert PDF tables into an Excel file.
- [Extract PDF Pages](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-extract-pages): Extract specific pages into a new PDF.
- [Rotate PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-rotator): Rotate PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- [PDF Redactor](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-redactor): Black out sensitive information before sharing.
- [PDF Metadata Cleaner](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-metadata-cleaner): Remove hidden metadata from PDF files.
- [PDF Split by Content](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-smart-splitter): Auto-detect chapters and split into multiple PDFs.
- [PDF Form Filler](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-form-filler): Fill PDF form fields and add a signature in your browser.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-pptx): Convert PDF pages into a PowerPoint presentation.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pptx-to-pdf): Convert a PowerPoint file into a PDF.
- [Excel to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/excel-to-pdf): Convert an Excel spreadsheet into a PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-jpg): Export each PDF page as a JPG image.
- [JPG to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/jpg-to-pdf): Combine JPG images into a single PDF.
- [HTML to PDF](https://golana.online/tool/html-to-pdf): Convert HTML content or a web page into a PDF.
- [PDF to PDF/A](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-pdfa): Convert a PDF to an archival PDF/A document.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-to-markdown): Extract text from a PDF as a Markdown file.
- [Edit PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-editor): Add text, shapes, and images to a PDF.
- [Watermark PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-watermark): Add a text watermark to every page of a PDF.
- [Page Numbers](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-page-numbers): Add page numbers to every page of a PDF.
- [Crop PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-crop): Crop the margins or area of every PDF page.
- [Organize PDF](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-organize): Reorder, delete, or rotate pages in a PDF.
- [PDF Page Size Normalizer](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-page-size-normalizer): Convert all PDF pages to a uniform size like A4 or Letter.
- [PDF Margin Remover](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-margin-remover): Auto-detect and remove white margins from PDF pages.
- [PDF Table Extractor](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-table-extractor): Extract tables from PDF pages into CSV or XLSX.
- [PDF OCR Extractor](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-ocr-extractor): Extract text from scanned PDFs using browser-based OCR.
- [PDF Signature Verifier](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-signature-verifier): Verify digital signatures and certificate details in a PDF.
- [PDF Compare](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-compare): Compare two PDFs side-by-side and highlight differences.
- [PDF Repair Tool](https://golana.online/tool/pdf-repair): Attempt to recover corrupted or damaged PDF files.
- [Camera Scanner](https://golana.online/tool/camera-scanner-pdf): Scan documents with your camera and save as a PDF — all in your browser.
